Below is a quick‑look “long‑weekend” calendar for **Canada in 2023** based on the federal statutory holidays that create a three‑day break (Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday or Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday).  
*(If a holiday falls on a weekend it is usually observed on the following Monday, which still gives you a long weekend.)*  

| # | Holiday | 2023 Date | Observed (if weekend) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---|---------|-----------|-----------------------|-------------------|-------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | **Sunday Jan 1** | Observed **Mon Jan 2** | **Sat Dec 31 – Mon Jan 2** | Canada Day is on a Saturday, so the holiday is observed on Monday. |
| 2 | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario) | **Mon Feb 20** | – | **Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20** | Family Day is a provincial holiday; all four provinces observe it on the third Monday in February. |
| 3 | Good Friday | **Fri Apr 7** | – | **Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9** | Good Friday is a federal holiday in most provinces. |
| 4 | Victoria Day | **Mon May 22** | – | **Sat May 20 – Mon May 22** | Celebrates the birthday of Queen Victoria. |
| 5 | Canada Day | **Sat Jul 1** | Observed **Mon Jul 3** | **Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3** | Canada Day falls on a weekend, so the holiday is observed on the following Monday. |
| 6 | Labour Day | **Mon Sep 4** | – | **Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4** | First Monday in September. |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | **Mon Oct 9** | – | **Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9** | Second Monday in October. |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | **Fri Nov 11** | – | **Fri Nov 11 – Sun Nov 13** | Observed on Friday in most provinces. |
| 9 | Christmas Day | **Mon Dec 25** | – | **Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25** | Christmas is a federal holiday. |

### Quick Summary

| Month | Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday |
|-------|--------------------|---------|
| Jan | Dec 31 – Jan 2 | New Year’s Day |
| Feb | Feb 18 – 20 | Family Day |
| Apr | Apr 7 – 9 | Good Friday |
| May | May 20 – 22 | Victoria Day |
| Jul | Jul 1 – 3 | Canada Day |
| Sep | Sep 2 – 4 | Labour Day |
| Oct | Oct 7 – 9 | Thanksgiving |
| Nov | Nov 11 – 13 | Remembrance Day |
| Dec | Dec 23 – 25 | Christmas Day |

> **Pro‑Tip:**  
> • If you’re planning trips in a specific province, check that province’s *provincial holidays* (e.g., Family Day in Ontario, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.).  
> • Some provinces observe **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) as a statutory holiday, but because it falls on a Tuesday in 2023 it does **not** create a long weekend.  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app, and let me know if you’d like a province‑specific version or any additional details!
